original_question: In the six-vertex model on a square lattice with domain wall boundary conditions, the arrows on the upper and lower boundaries point into the lattice while the arrows on the left and right boundaries point out. Determine the bulk correlation functions and the boundary correlation functions for this model, despite the loss of translation invariance caused by the boundary conditions.

refined_question: For the six-vertex model on a finite N×N square lattice with domain wall boundary conditions—arrows on the upper and lower boundaries pointing into the lattice and arrows on the left and right boundaries pointing out—obtain explicit formulas for the correlation functions both in the bulk and at the boundary, extending beyond the presently known determinant formulas for the 1-point and 2-point boundary correlators in this non-translation-invariant setting. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/cond-mat/0701491))
justification: The draft is already very close to the paper’s actual intent. The nearest official formulation is the open problem at the end of Section V.3. The surrounding context in Section V defines DWBC, emphasizes that the difficulty comes from the loss of translation invariance, and records the existing partial progress on boundary correlations before posing the broader problem. The rewrite therefore keeps the scope narrow: it asks for bulk and boundary correlation functions for the six-vertex model with DWBC on a finite square lattice, without broadening to asymptotics, other boundary conditions, or unrelated combinatorial generalizations. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/cond-mat/0701491))
